text: Milk Academy, Fenerbahce basketball's arm (sleeve) sponsor, was founded in 2006 and produces at its plants in Bursa; Turkish sports-wire reporting states it joined Cabir Holding in 2023. A second trade-press piece confirms it as the men's team's official jersey sponsor for 2025-26.
short: Milk Academy is a Bursa dairy producer reported to be part of Cabir Holding since 2023.

source.name: Turkspor Ajansi - Fenerbahce, Beko'ya iki yeni sponsor
source.quote: 2006 yılında kurulan ve Bursa'daki tesislerinde üretim yapan Milk Academy
